title: horsfieldia polyspherula var. sumatrana
intro: Horsfieldia polyspherula var. sumatrana, commonly known as Sumatran horsfieldia, is a plant species in the family Myristicaceae. It is traditionally used in Southeast Asian medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Sumatran horsfieldia include wound healing, pain relief, and the treatment of respiratory and gastrointestinal issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
